slides.title: Number of the Week
slides.body: The S&P 500 slid from 7,561.67 (Nov 13) to 7,175.83 (Nov 19), its sixth straight loss and 8.2% below October's record. The Dow closed below 50,000 at 49,097.06.

slides.title: Story 1: AI Stocks Led the Drop
slides.subtitle: S&P 500 daily change (bar = size of drop)
slides.body: Nvidia's $115.8B quarter (Nov 17) did not end the slide. Over 90% of S&P 500 stocks fell Thursday.

slides.title: Story 2: Fed Minutes
slides.body: Minutes (Nov 18): the Fed held at 3.75% to 4% in October, 10 to 2, with two votes for a quarter-point hike. Almost all officials see more hikes as likely. Markets fully price one on Dec 8-9.

slides.title: Save This: What to Watch Next
items: Nov 26: US stock markets closed for Thanksgiving
Dec 8-9: Fed meeting, 0.25-point hike priced in
